kapak.alt: A cell plug in the womb, and atresia

youtube.baslik: Is the ear canal closed for a while before birth? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: At the start of the third month, cells in the developing ear canal multiply and form a cell plug that blocks the canal; this plug breaks down at about the seventh month, and the canal opens again. If the canal does not open, congenital aural atresia results; the loss is conductive and often around 50 to 60 decibels. If the inner ear is normal, bone conduction thresholds are also normal.
